suggestions: I'm grateful for the quiet moments before Fajr that allow me to start my day with a centered and peaceful mind.
I'm thankful for a clean pull request review that gets approved with all green CI checks.
I'm grateful for a comforting cup of teh tarik during a much-needed break from the screen.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a stable job that challenges me and allows me to provide for my family.
I'm grateful for that sudden 'aha!' moment when a stubborn bug finally gets resolved.
I'm thankful for the cool breeze and the sound of heavy rain cooling down the afternoon heat.
I'm grateful for a smooth, drama-free production deployment that lets me log off on time.
I'm thankful for spontaneous evening mamak sessions with good friends to unwind and laugh.
I'm grateful for supportive teammates who readily jump into a call to help unblock a difficult issue.
I'm thankful for the peaceful pause during Friday prayers to reset my perspective and recharge spiritually.
I'm grateful for a delicious home-cooked meal waiting for me after a mentally exhausting workday.
I'm thankful for the flexibility of working from home on days when the highway traffic is overwhelming.
I'm grateful for unexpectedly well-documented code that makes implementing a new feature painless.
I'm thankful for the health, clarity, and energy to keep learning and sharpening my technical skills.
I'm grateful for an evening walk around the neighborhood to unplug from monitors and breathe in fresh air.
